'''Viacheslav Valentinovich Nikulin (Slava)''' is a Russian mathematician working in the [[algebraic geometry]] of [[K3 surface]]s and [[Calabi–Yau manifold|Calabi–Yau threefold]]s, [[Mirror symmetry (string theory)|mirror symmetry]], the arithmetic of [[quadratic form]]s, and hyperbolic [[Kac–Moody algebra]]s.<ref name="VV">[https://www.liv.ac.uk/maths/PURE/MIN_SET/CONTENT/members/V_Nikulin.html Nikulin's University of Liverpool webpage]</ref> He is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Liverpool]]. A third chair of mathematics was established for Nikulin in 1999, the second chair having been established in 1964 for [[C. T. C. Wall]] and the first having been established in 1882.<ref>[http://www.liv.ac.uk/commsec/calendar_07_08/emprofs_profs_hongrads.htm University of Liverpool Committee Secretariat] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090427163415/http://www.liv.ac.uk/commsec/calendar_07_08/emprofs_profs_hongrads.htm |date=April 27, 2009 }}</ref> Nikulin has made contributions towards the solution of [[Hilbert's sixteenth problem|Hilbert's 16th problem]].<ref>{{Citation|first=B. H.|last=Yandell|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=XQXoG4pL1-kC&q=+Nikulin|title=The Honors Class: Hilbert's Problems and Their Solvers|publisher=A K Peters|year=2004|page=278|isbn=1-56881-216-7}}</ref>
